# Getting support

Start at the [Scarp support hub](https://scarp-lang.github.io/support/).
It links installation, diagnostics, compatibility, module, and execution-budget
guides, plus English and Hindi troubleshooting material.

The [guided report builder](https://scarp-lang.github.io/support/#draft-builder)
prepares an editable draft in your browser. It routes to the language, docs, or
website repository; you review and submit the final issue on GitHub. Long drafts
can be copied into the issue form instead of encoded into a link.

Choose the tracker that matches the problem:

- Language, CLI, or runtime: <https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp/issues>
- Documentation or translations: <https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp-docs/issues>
- This project website: <https://github.com/scarp-lang/scarp-lang.github.io/issues>

Search existing issues first. Include the Scarp version, operating system and CPU,
exact command, a minimal reproducer, expected behavior, and actual output. For a
website problem, include the affected page, browser, and device/viewport details.
Issues are public: remove credentials and private information before posting.

General project correspondence: <scarplang@gmail.com>. Technical reports should
normally use the public trackers so others can reproduce and follow the fix.
Support is community based and has no guaranteed response time.
